ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution exceeding 90% of the fluke surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in small discrete clusters and linear patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity mottled cluster on the upper-left lobe; localized high-intensity linear marks in the central-left region; scattered high-intensity pixel points on the distal right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; walls converge at approximately 30-40 degrees with a rounded vertex base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; moderate-amplitude peaks and valleys on the right lobe trailing edge, with a significant jagged protrusion near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of approximately 10-15 high-intensity circular pixel blobs (barnacles) on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel, horizontal high-intensity lines (rake marks) in the upper-left central region; single diagonal linear disruption on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks on the left lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on the distal right tip.
